purpose: Visual check S1 (09.11.2026): one identical scene in 3-4 candidate looks so Marcel can choose the base style (concept: low-poly 3D, toon shader, outlines; style changes with the era; voxel as alternative).
scene: Isometric bird's-eye view of the whole small island, centred in the picture and surrounded by calm sea: a sandy beach, a green meadow, a small forest, a clear stream running from a spring into the sea, a few grey rocks, fruit trees and berry bushes. Two adult inhabitants, a grown man and a grown woman with adult body proportions in simple plain clothes, stand on the beach a few steps apart and look around curiously. Soft morning light, peaceful and friendly mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

variants.label_de: Low-Poly mit Toon-Shader und Konturen (Grundlook laut Konzept)
variants.style: Low-poly 3D game art: every object built from large flat-shaded polygon facets, two-tone cel shading, thick black outlines around every object and character, bright friendly colours.

Rough charcoal and graphite sketch on rough paper: visible hatching and cross-hatching strokes, smudged charcoal shading, dark sketchy outlines, almost monochrome earthy browns and greys with only a few muted colour accents.
Hand-inked comic book illustration of a low-poly world: bold uneven ink lines, halftone dot shading, warm saturated sunset-like colours, painterly comic panel look.
Voxel art 3D game style, everything built from small cubes, soft ambient occlusion, clean pastel colours.

changes: v1 review: toon and comic looked alike and lacked outlines; inhabitants looked like children; framing varied (close-up vs. whole island). v2 fixes the framing, makes the inhabitants adults and makes each style more distinct.
